_note: The herd: plain pets fold into a count per rarity x finish (Collection, Herd). Every number here is a placeholder. keep_cards: each shelf keeps its newest this many plain pets as full cards. card_from: this finish and better is always a card. cushion: pets on the pink cushion on top of the bookcase. standing: the newest this many stand on a plank. mound_max: the most tiny pets drawn in a plank's mound. shelf_page: always-cards shown at once on an opened shelf. stand_ins: pets from one count offered for an adventure at a time. fallen_keep: stars remembered one by one (the rest are only counted). room: one cap for every plain pet together (pets on jobs too), grown a step at a time on the house card (HouseCard): start is the room before any step; each step says how many it holds (cap) and costs ONE currency: capsules (coins: capsules x what a plain capsule is worth on the machine now, like errand tools and boxes) or wisps (the squeeze-in steps, hidden until wisps exist); after the listed steps, more keeps going forever: each one holds grow x the last and costs wisps_grow x the last; cozy_at: how full the room is when its pill turns cozy; old_save_margin: a save from before the room gets room for its pets plus this much.
